en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a complex of long, pale buildings with red-tiled roofs identified as the 'Jäger-Kaserne' (riflemen's barracks) in front of steep green hills and cliffs with a tall waterfall cascading down the rock face. The scene is set in a mountainous landscape and printed text in the top right corner reads 'Trient Jäger-Kaserne'. The edges of the card show some wear and aging.
